exact_invariants.statement: A9.26 owner arithmetic reproduced exactly (both, and the committed record): rollups[0] nonharness_known_kg 33.1196, harness_kg 1.743136842, nominal_dry_known_kg 34.86273684, system_margin_kg 3.486273684, dry_known_kg 38.34901052 (owner ~38.3490); HARD_40_WET wet 40.34901052 / 43.34901052 / 48.34901052 kg at 2 / 5 / 10 kg loaded Xe, each DOES_NOT_CLOSE (owner ~40.3490 / 43.3490 / 48.3490); lines_without_value []; mass_status.status 'MASS INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / NOT_YET_CLOSED'

roll-up arithmetic: dry = non-harness x (1 / 0.95) x line factors x system margin: dry_known_kg == rk(rk(nh + rk(nh x 0.05 / 0.95)) x 1.1) with nh the sum of the ten MEV line values, |dry_known_kg - nh / 0.95 x 1.1| <= 5e-9 x dry_known_kg; the line factors: AL-04 / AL-07 / AL-08 value_kg == rk(evidence floor x 1.20) (4.2048 / 6.0 / 5.9148; MEV_PLANNING_FLOOR) and the effective factor 1.32 = rk(1.20 x 1.10) in margin_audit
